jobs.description:
As a Business Analyst, you start from the business and its processes rather than from a predefined IT solution. You engage with various stakeholders, identify their challenges and needs, and seek to understand how processes actually work today.
You analyze the current way of working, identify bottlenecks and opportunities, and work together with the business to define a clear as-is and to-be situation. You ask critical questions, align different interests and help determine which changes can deliver the greatest added value.
You then translate these insights into clear business requirements, processes, objectives and solution directions. Throughout this process, you maintain a view of the bigger picture and ensure that proposed solutions align with operational reality and the broader digitalization strategy.
You work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, Architects, Functional Analysts and development teams. While the more functional or technical profiles focus in greater detail on the concrete software implementation, you remain primarily responsible for the business context, process logic, scope and stakeholder alignment.
Throughout the project, you remain involved in validation and decision-making, ensuring that the final solution genuinely addresses the original business problem.

• 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role. More experience is certainly welcome
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
• You have strong communication skills and can interact comfortably with operational employees, management and IT professionals
• You communicate professionally in English and understand Dutch and/or French

Our client is a large Belgian organization that plays a key role within an extensive and technically complex infrastructure environment. Behind the scenes, business-critical IT systems ensure that operational processes can run safely, reliably and efficiently.
As part of a broad IT digitalization program, significant investments will be made over the coming years in renewing and optimizing processes, applications and digital services. To support this transformation, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst who can immerse themselves in the business and help determine where and how digitalization can genuinely create value.
This is a long-term project within a stable enterprise environment, with contracts that can be renewed annually.

Middlegate Europe is a leading player in European logistics and distribution. With operational sites

in Zeebrugge, Liège, and Hull, the company combines innovative processes with a strong focus on safety,

quality, and operational reliability. To strengthen the team in Zeebrugge, Middlegate Europe is looking for an

International Truck Driver.
 

JOB DESCRIPTION
 
 

• Responsible for delivering goods within the specified time frame. 

• Complying with legal driving and rest periods. 

• Assisting with loading and unloading trucks and ensuring the cargo is secured. 

• Ensuring the vehicle is kept in perfect condition and clean. 

PROFILE
 
 

• You have a valid CE driver’s license. 

• You have some initial experience as a CE driver. 

• You are punctual, professional, and thorough in your work. 

• You speak Dutch or English well. 

• You have a flexible mindset. 

• You’re willing to spend the night on location.

Due to a large number of opportunities, we are looking for a driven 
Sales Coordinator / Tender Specialist to strengthen the Sarens Projects team. In this role, you aim to provide clients with a structured, solution-oriented, and clear proposal within the agreed timeline. In collaboration with the Key Account Manager, you clarify the proposal and respond to the client's questions. 
 

Your future responsibilities as a Tender Specialist include: 
 

• Analyzing and summarizing client requests. 
 

• Developing proposals for technical requests and projects in collaboration with the responsible Key Account Manager to achieve the best balance between budget, scope, and timing according to client needs. 
 

• During the bidding process, you collaborate with various support departments such as engineering, logistics, HR, SHEQ, finance, etc. You coordinate their input and deliverables while respecting deadlines to create a structured, high-quality proposal that meets both internal and external expectations. 
 

• Regularly consulting with the responsible Key Account Manager and the sales support team about the proposed solution, adjusting as needed. 
 

• Gathering the necessary cost inputs, preparing a price calculation, and reviewing it with the Key Account Manager and/or management. 
 

• Timely and accurately submitting proposals/tender documents after internal approval and following up on them with the Key Account Manager. Responding to internal and external questions and making adjustments where needed. 
 

• Acting at all times as a proud 
Sarens Ambassador and providing general sales support to the group. 

We are looking for a stress-resistant multitasker with a hands-on mentality, strong writing skills, and a solution-focused, positive attitude. You have a strong interest in the world of specialized transport and heavy lifting. You possess good reading and listening skills, enabling you to detect and anticipate customer needs. You think outside the box in search of the best solution. You are a sociable team player with a strong sense of responsibility. You work in a structured and precise manner, with attention to detail. Customer focus, drive, and proactivity are key to success in this role. 
 

Your profile: 
 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field (engineering, electromechanics, construction...) or equivalent through experience. 
 

• Interest in or experience with sales support, technical inside sales, tender engineering, etc. 
 

• Technical knowledge of heavy lifting and/or exceptional transport, or a strong eagerness to learn and acquire this knowledge quickly. • Strong communicator in Dutch; good knowledge of English and French. 
 

• Proficient with computers (including MS Office).

For a leading US company with its European headquarters in Brussels, we are looking for an Accounting Specialist. You will join an international environment where Finance, Operations, HR, Tax, and Real Estate work closely together. This role exists to ensure that accounting and reporting processes across multiple markets are carried out accurately and on time. We are looking for someone who is analytically strong, communicates fluently, and feels comfortable in a dynamic and collaborative culture.

Your responsibilities

• 
Coordinate the administration of invoices and obligations related to leasing, housekeeping, payroll, property taxes, and travel expenses.

• 
Monitor budgets and analyze deviations in recurring costs and monthly closings.

• 
Oversee reconciliations, intercompany positions, and payroll reconciliations.

• 
Prepare VAT, property tax, and other tax filings in collaboration with the Tax department.

• 
Support external audits, year-end closing, and the preparation of statutory financial statements.

• 
Assist in the integration of new or acquired stores into accounting processes.

• 
Contribute to ESG data collection, budget preparation, and process improvements.

• 
Support and coach team members and new colleagues where necessary.

Your profile

• 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience.

• 
At least 5 years of experience in accounting.

• 
Experience with financial statements, IFRS, and local GAAP.

• 
Experience in services or retail is required.

• 
Experience with SAP; knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is a plus.

• 
Experience with ERP/CRM migrations and UAT is an advantage.

• 
Fluent in English and French; German is a strong plus.

• 
Strong skills in Excel and Microsoft Office.

• 
Accurate, independent, communicative, and solution-oriented.

For a growing organisation in the services sector we are looking for a Finance Operations Specialist. 

You will work closely with local accounting teams and other internal stakeholders across Europe.

Your Responsibilities

• 
Monitor expenses and commitments for real estate projects across Europe

• 
Support the preparation and review of local GAAP accounting memos

• 
Manage the daily administration of invoices and purchase orders

• 
Review and analyze invoice postings, including VAT and entity details

• 
Analyze new real estate projects such as construction, renovation, and maintenance

• 
Support communication with external parties such as contractors, suppliers, and government authorities

• 
Assist with the financial reporting of investment projects (actuals, budget, and forecast)

• 
Follow up on payment schedules together with local accounting teams

• 
Support month-end and quarter-end closings within real estate accounting

• 
Assist with depreciation, capitalization, and reconciliations

• 
Support internal and external audits

• 
Contribute to ESG reporting

• 
Assist in implementing procedures and control systems in line with internal standards

• 
Support the rollout of control processes across different markets

• 
Support process improvements and special accounting projects

Your Profile

• 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience

• 
1–3 years of experience in accounting

• 
Experience in a real estate environment is a plus

• 
Fluent in English

• 
Experience in an international or shared services environment is a plus

• 
Knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP is an asset

• 
Proficient in Microsoft Office, with advanced Excel skills

• 
Experience with SAP S/4HANA is a plus

We are looking for a Technical Assistant to support the PALL (Product Assessment & Laundry Laboratory) team during a temporary assignment. In this hands-on role, you will perform laundry and wash performance tests, take technical measurements before and after washing cycles, maintain laboratory stock, and ensure accurate data collection and reporting. You will work in a team of three Technical Assistants and receive training on various testing methods and equipment.

In a nutshell you will: 

 
• Perform laundry and wash performance tests according to established procedures. 
 

 
• Take measurements using laboratory equipment (e.g. spectrophotometer). 
 
• Record, verify, and upload test data accurately. 
Maintain testing materials and laboratory stock. 

 
• Communicate with internal stakeholders regarding test requests, observations, and results. 
 
•  
Report any irregularities or unexpected findings during testing.

 
• Available full-time from September 22 through December 23. 
 

 
• Able to work daily from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM. 
 
•  
Accurate, reliable, and detail-oriented. 

 
•  
Comfortable working in a practical, laboratory-based environment. 

 
• Good communication skills in English. 
 

 
• Basic computer skills (Outlook, Excel, and willingness to learn internal systems). 
 

 
• Open to coaching and eager to learn new testing methods. 
 
•  
Able to handle laundry baskets of approximately 3 kg using provided ergonomic equipment.

I am looking for an energetic, friendly and kind trilingual secretary to join my new private gynaecological practice.
 

The successful candidate must be fluent in Dutch, English and French. This is a part-time, on-site position starting on 7 December 2026.
 

Responsibilities include:
 
 

• Answering telephone calls and assisting patients 

• Managing the reception desk 

• Scheduling and following up on appointments 

• Tracking and ordering practice supplies 

• Cleaning and preparing medical instruments according to protocol 

• Supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice  

A warm, professional and patient-centred attitude is essential.
